methods.label: Read the logarithm as an exponent
methods.explanation:
The base-\(2\) logarithm asks which exponent of \(2\) produces \(0.0625\). Rewrite the decimal as a power of \(2\):
\[
0.0625=\frac{625}{10000}
=\frac1{16}=\frac1{2^4}=2^{-4}.
\]
Therefore \(\log_2(0.0625)=-4\), choice D.
methods.levelReason: The definition of a logarithm, decimal-to-fraction conversion, and negative integer exponents suffice.
